facts.business: Grauer & Weil (India) Limited (Growel) offers fully integrated corrosion protection and surface enhancement solutions across diverse substrates and industries, with a portfolio spanning advanced specialty chemicals, industrial coatings, engineering systems, lubricants and real estate.
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions are negotiated on an arm's length basis and are intended to further the Company's interests. There are no materially significant related party transactions that had potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large. During the year under review, no material RPTs were proposed, in which approval of the Members was required.
